why: An open critical incident constrains changes that DEPEND on it; unrelated low-effect docs and non-protected tests may proceed only under explicit safeWorkScope.allowPatterns. Unknown or privileged effects require incident-scoped repairs with authenticated authority. Incident visibility failure cannot mint authority from commit trailers.

llm-router.repairProtocol: issue body of the open [lane] llm-router incident

otto.repairProtocol: issue body of the open [lane] otto incident

estate-doors.repairProtocol: issue body of the open [lane] estate-doors incident

dof-probe.repairProtocol: BLIND incident inventory is not a real repair ticket. Restore independently authenticated incident visibility or obtain an independently signed, patch-bound trusted recovery permit; never treat Genesis-Resolves:dof-probe as approval.

safeWorkScope.why: Only reviewed, explicitly listed low-effect paths are eligible while a different service is unavailable. Outside substrateScope alone is NOT proof of independence; protected controls and mixes with unknown effects are always blocked.
safeWorkScope.rule: EVERY changed path must match allowPatterns and NO changed path may match substrateScope, immutableWhileRed or neverSafe; no trailer may bootstrap an unreadable incident inventory.

control.reason: Founder 2026-11-13: force DoF; a critical service down narrows every agent to its repair
control.reenableOnlyAfter: independently reconciled backlog of accepted tickets, branches, worktrees and reviewed changes, verified against main and runtime yield
